problem_text:
A logistics manager must allocate a fleet of transport vehicles to deliver a set of specialized cargo containers to a remote site. Each container offers a certain utility score, but occupies a specific amount of loading space. The goal is to maximize the total utility of the delivered containers without exceeding the total available cargo bay volume.

The available containers are:
* Container 1: volume 27 cubic meters, utility 196 units
* Container 2: volume 38 cubic meters, utility 288 units
* Container 3: volume 12 cubic meters, utility 56 units
* Container 4: volume 50 cubic meters, utility 70 units
* Container 5: volume 9 cubic meters, utility 216 units
* Container 6: volume 18 cubic meters, utility 53 units
* Container 7: volume 35 cubic meters, utility 158 units
* Container 8: volume 34 cubic meters, utility 95 units
* Container 9: volume 46 cubic meters, utility 252 units
* Container 10: volume 27 cubic meters, utility 135 units
* Container 11: volume 24 cubic meters, utility 150 units
* Container 12: volume 18 cubic meters, utility 178 units
* Container 13: volume 12 cubic meters, utility 142 units
* Container 14: volume 14 cubic meters, utility 60 units
* Container 15: volume 19 cubic meters, utility 207 units
* Container 16: volume 26 cubic meters, utility 183 units
* Container 17: volume 30 cubic meters, utility 58 units
* Container 18: volume 43 cubic meters, utility 45 units
* Container 19: volume 36 cubic meters, utility 134 units
* Container 20: volume 11 cubic meters, utility 244 units
* Container 21: volume 13 cubic meters, utility 194 units
* Container 22: volume 49 cubic meters, utility 146 units
* Container 23: volume 3 cubic meters, utility 79 units
* Container 24: volume 1 cubic meter, utility 198 units
* Container 25: volume 29 cubic meters, utility 156 units
* Container 26: volume 43 cubic meters, utility 299 units
* Container 27: volume 20 cubic meters, utility 178 units
* Container 28: volume 12 cubic meters, utility 17 units

Due to compatibility constraints, exactly one of Container 1 and Container 2 can be included in the shipment.

If Container 3 is selected, it requires special handling equipment that permanently occupies an additional 10 cubic meters of the cargo bay's effective capacity.
The total usable cargo bay volume is limited to 489 cubic meters. The manager must determine the optimal selection of containers to load.
